title: Basic Training Blueprint+
subtitle: British Army assessment + Basic Training preparation
level: All levels - choose Foundation or Build
tagline: Pass assessment. Arrive ready. Leave nothing on the table.
purpose: Build the aerobic fitness, maximal and explosive strength, useful muscle, strength endurance, running durability and repeatable work capacity needed to arrive ready for British Army Basic Training.
independent_disclaimer: The Basic Training Blueprint is produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. It is not produced, approved or endorsed by the British Army or the Ministry of Defence. Current Army role pages remain the source of truth for entry standards.

weeks.title: Establish the baseline
weeks.checkpoint: Collect honest starting data, learn the movement standards and finish every session with something left.

sessions.title: Lower-body baseline + pull position
sessions.purpose: Set a safe strength baseline and learn the force position used for the Mid-Thigh Pull.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up, then 3 progressive deadlift warm-up sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 5 at RPE 6-7. Rest 2-3 min. Record load and RPE.

blocks.name: Pull skill
blocks.instruction: Secure rack isometric at mid-thigh: 3 x 3 sec at RPE 6-7. If the setup is not immovable, omit it.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 3 x 8; rear-foot elevated split squat 2 x 10 each leg; hamstring curl 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Standing calf raise 3 x 12; tibialis raise 3 x 15; suitcase carry 3 x 20 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: No maximums. The baseline must be technically clean and repeatable.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic base + strides
sessions.purpose: Build continuous aerobic work without turning an easy day into a test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk, then start very easily.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 25-35 min at RPE 4-5. Full sentences should be possible.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 3 min run / 1 min walk for the full duration if continuous running is not yet comfortable.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 15 sec relaxed accelerations with 60-75 sec walking recovery.

blocks.name: Lower leg
blocks.instruction: 2 rounds: 12 bent-knee calf raises, 12 straight-knee calf raises, 20 sec single-leg balance each side.

sessions.coach_note: Easy work builds fitness and recovery. Do not race the watch.

sessions.title: Upper-body baseline + throw test
sessions.purpose: Measure the seated throw and begin building the pressing and pulling muscle behind it.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up plus 2-3 progressive practice throws.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 scored attempts. Record the best valid distance.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 3 x 8 at RPE 6-7. Rest 2 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 3 x 10; pulldown or assisted pull-up 3 x 8; half-kneeling press 2 x 10 each side.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 sets, stopping 3 reps before failure; dead bug 2 x 8 each side.

sessions.coach_note: Power comes first while fresh. More tired throws are not better throws.

sessions.title: 2 km baseline assessment
sessions.purpose: Establish the running result that will set the next block of training.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running, drills, 3 strides, then the official-style 800 m progressive warm-up.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Run 2 km continuously on a flat measured course at best sustainable effort. Record total time and splits.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: If you cannot run continuously, include short walks and record total elapsed time. It remains a valid baseline.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Walk 5 min, then jog easily for 8-10 min.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Note first and second kilometre splits, where pace changed and one cue for next time.

sessions.coach_note: Do not sprint the first 400 m. Pace it hard, not stupidly.

sessions.title: Soldier movement quality circuit
sessions.purpose: Introduce running, stepping, pushing, pulling, carrying and bracing without pack work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up and rehearse every movement.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 quality rounds: 250 m easy-moderate run, 8 step-ups each leg, 8-15 press-ups, 10 rows, 30 m farmer carry, 30 sec plank.

blocks.name: Rest
blocks.instruction: Rest 90 sec between rounds. Use low-impact bike or rower for 60 sec instead of the run if needed.

blocks.name: Grip
blocks.instruction: Dead hang or heavy static hold: 3 x 20-40 sec.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record movement versions and whether round four matched round one.

sessions.coach_note: This is controlled capacity work, not a punishment session.

weeks.title: Build consistency and muscle
weeks.checkpoint: Accumulate useful training volume. Stay three reps from failure on most assistance work.

sessions.title: Deadlift volume + lower hypertrophy
sessions.purpose: Increase useful lower-body volume while keeping every rep technically consistent.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up plus progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 5 at RPE 7. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Secondary
blocks.instruction: Goblet or front squat: 3 x 8 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Walking lunge 3 x 10 each leg; Romanian deadlift 3 x 10; calf raise 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Tibialis raise 3 x 15; suitcase carry 3 x 25 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: Add load only if the final deadlift set still looks like the first.

sessions.title: Aerobic base + strides
sessions.purpose: Extend easy work so hard sessions cost less and recovery improves.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk into an easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 30-40 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Alternate 5 min run / 1 min walk for the full duration.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 15 sec relaxed-fast with 60 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Foot and ankle
blocks.instruction: Short-foot hold 2 x 20 sec; single-leg calf raise 2 x 12; balance 2 x 20 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: Duration rises this week. Pace does not need to rise as well.

sessions.title: Throw quality + upper hypertrophy
sessions.purpose: Improve throw mechanics and add balanced upper-body muscle.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light chest passes.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 5 x 3 with full reset and 60-90 sec rest.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press or dumbbell bench: 4 x 8 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Pull + press
blocks.instruction: Pulldown or assisted pull-up 4 x 8; overhead press 3 x 10; one-arm row 3 x 10 each side.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy finish
blocks.instruction: Lateral raise 2 x 15 + curl 2 x 12 + press-ups 2 quality sets.

sessions.coach_note: Stop each throw set when speed or technique falls.

sessions.title: Short aerobic-power intervals
sessions.purpose: Develop speed and running mechanics without excessive high-intensity volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 3 x 15 sec strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 8 x 1 min at RPE 8 with 90 sec easy jog or walk. Keep hard reps within a similar distance.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Complete 6 reps first. Add reps 7-8 only if mechanics and pace remain stable.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min very easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record distance or pace for every hard minute.

sessions.coach_note: The last rep may be hard; it should not be dramatically slower.

sessions.title: 20-minute quality EMOM
sessions.purpose: Practise repeatable output using simple soldier-relevant movement patterns.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: EMOM x 20
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 45 sec easy-hard run, bike or row. Min 2: 10 step-ups total. Min 3: 8-15 press-ups. Min 4: 8-12 rows. Min 5: rest. Repeat 4 times.

blocks.name: Rule
blocks.instruction: Each work minute must finish with at least 10 sec spare. Reduce reps before form changes.

blocks.name: Carry
blocks.instruction: Farmer carry 4 x 30 m at RPE 6-7.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: Side plank 2 x 25 sec each side; easy 5 min cool-down.

sessions.coach_note: EMOM means quality on the minute, not panic for the full minute.

weeks.title: Build the engine and the frame
weeks.checkpoint: This is the first substantial build week. Eat, sleep and keep the easy run easy.

sessions.title: Strength build + pull intent
sessions.purpose: Develop more force through the hips and legs while retaining useful muscle-building volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up; broad jump 4 x 3 with full reset.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 4 at RPE 7-8. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Pull skill
blocks.instruction: Secure mid-thigh rack isometric: 4 x 3 sec at RPE 8. Omit if setup is not immovable.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Front-foot elevated split squat 3 x 8 each leg; Romanian deadlift 3 x 8; leg curl 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Calf raise 4 x 12; tibialis raise 3 x 15; farmer carry 4 x 25 m.

sessions.coach_note: High intent never excuses a poor position.

sessions.title: Long easy aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Increase aerobic capacity and running durability through controlled continuous work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk and easy jog.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 35-45 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 4 min run / 1 min walk for the full duration.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record duration, distance and whether the final 10 min stayed controlled.

sessions.coach_note: Despite being longer, this should be the easiest-feeling session of the week.

sessions.title: Upper power + push-pull muscle
sessions.purpose: Connect explosive throwing with stronger pressing, pulling and shoulders.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and progressive medicine-ball practice.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Push press 5 x 3 at RPE 7; seated 4 kg throw 5 x 3. Full recovery.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press 3 x 8 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Pull-up, assisted pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6-10; one-arm row 3 x 10; incline dumbbell press 3 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Face pull 2 x 15; press-ups 2 repeatable sets; Pallof press 2 x 10 each side.

sessions.coach_note: Power work ends when repetitions slow down.

sessions.title: Two-minute intervals
sessions.purpose: Build speed endurance near 2 km effort while preserving repeatability.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 2 min at RPE 8 with 2 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Build option
blocks.instruction: Complete 7-8 reps only if every prior rep is within roughly 3 percent and posture remains relaxed.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record pace or distance for each repetition.

sessions.coach_note: Extra repetitions are earned through consistency, not enthusiasm.

sessions.title: 20-minute soldier AMRAP
sessions.purpose: Build enjoyable whole-body work capacity with no pack or loaded marching.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: AMRAP x 20
blocks.instruction: 200 m run, 10 goblet squats, 8-15 press-ups, 10 rows, 30 m farmer carry, 8 step-ups each leg. Repeat for quality rounds.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 60 sec bike or row; incline press-ups; bodyweight squat; band rows.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Quality cap
blocks.instruction: Work at RPE 7. Stop one round early if movement quality or running mechanics change.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy walk or bike plus calf and hip mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Round one should feel conservative. Repeatability is the score.

weeks.title: Deload and absorb
weeks.checkpoint: Reduce volume by roughly one third. Finish the week feeling better than you started.

sessions.title: Light lower-body strength
sessions.purpose: Retain movement quality while fatigue falls.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 5 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Secondary
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 2 x 8; split squat 2 x 8 each leg.

blocks.name: Durability
blocks.instruction: Calf raise 2 x 12; tibialis raise 2 x 12; single-leg balance 2 x 20 sec.

blocks.name: Flush
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy bike or walk.

sessions.coach_note: Everything should feel crisp. Do not add the work back.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic reset
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic consistency with very little fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Begin with 5 min walking.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 25-30 min at RPE 3-4. Use run/walk freely.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 3 x 12 sec smooth accelerations, not sprints.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min ankles, calves, hips and upper back.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record energy and lower-leg comfort.

sessions.coach_note: Finish fresher than you began.

sessions.title: Light upper-body technique
sessions.purpose: Keep throwing and strength patterns familiar without soreness.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light throws.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated medicine-ball throw: 3 x 3 at 80-90 percent effort.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench or dumbbell bench: 3 x 6 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Chest-supported row 3 x 8; half-kneeling press 2 x 8 each side; face pull 2 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 2 easy press-up sets and 5 min mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Leave wanting to do more. That is the correct result.

sessions.title: Technique fartlek
sessions.purpose: Keep some faster running without creating a hard interval hangover.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy run.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 30 sec at RPE 7 with 90 sec easy jog.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min easy running.

blocks.name: Drills
blocks.instruction: 2 rounds: A-march, ankling, then 2 x 15 sec relaxed strides.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Walk until breathing is fully controlled.

sessions.coach_note: Fast enough to feel smooth, not fast enough to create fatigue.

sessions.title: Movement quality circuit
sessions.purpose: Maintain general capacity while reducing impact and total work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy cardio.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.instruction: 3 easy rounds: 8 step-ups each leg, 10 incline or floor press-ups, 10 rows, 20 m light carry, 30 sec plank. Rest as needed.

blocks.name: Easy flush
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min bike, row or brisk walk at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: Longer calf, hip and shoulder mobility.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Write one thing improving and one thing requiring attention.

sessions.coach_note: No score and no race. Move well and recover.

weeks.title: Build strength and threshold
weeks.checkpoint: Loads rise through RPE, not ego. The quality run becomes longer but remains controlled.

sessions.title: Heavy triples + lower muscle
sessions.purpose: Increase maximal-force capacity while maintaining the legs and trunk needed to repeat work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up; broad jump 4 x 3 with full reset.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 3 at RPE 8. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Pull skill
blocks.instruction: Secure mid-thigh isometric: 4 x 3 sec at RPE 8-9. Full 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Bulgarian split squat 3 x 8 each leg; hamstring curl 3 x 10; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Tibialis raise 3 x 15; farmer carry 4 x 30 m at RPE 7-8.

sessions.coach_note: RPE 8 means two good reps remain, not an ugly near-maximum.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic + strides
sessions.purpose: Protect the aerobic base while the specific running session becomes harder.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk into easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 35-45 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 6 min run / 1 min walk.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Lower leg
blocks.instruction: Calf raise 2 x 15; tibialis raise 2 x 15; balance 2 x 25 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: A faster easy pace is welcome only if speech stays comfortable.

sessions.title: Bench strength + throw power
sessions.purpose: Build pressing force, then express it quickly in the assessment throw.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light throws.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg throw: 5 x 3 with full recovery.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press: 5 x 5 at RPE 8. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6-8; one-arm row 3 x 10; dumbbell overhead press 3 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Lateral raise 2 x 15 + curl 2 x 12 + press-ups 2 quality sets.

sessions.coach_note: Throws come before heavy pressing so the test skill stays fast.

sessions.title: Threshold intervals
sessions.purpose: Raise the pace you can sustain before fatigue rises sharply.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 x 4 min at RPE 7-8 with 2 min easy jog. Keep pace stable.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Complete 3 x 4 min. Add the fourth only when the first three are controlled.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record pace and RPE for each interval.

sessions.coach_note: Threshold is controlled discomfort, not sprinting.

sessions.title: 25-minute strength-endurance EMOM
sessions.purpose: Develop repeated lifting, stepping, pushing and pulling without unnecessary impact.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: EMOM x 25
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 10-12 bike or row calories. Min 2: 10 sandbag or dumbbell deadlifts. Min 3: 12 step-ups total. Min 4: 8-15 press-ups + 8 rows. Min 5: rest. Repeat 5 times.

blocks.name: Rule
blocks.instruction: Use loads that leave 10-15 sec spare and at least two good reps in reserve.

blocks.name: Carry
blocks.instruction: Suitcase carry 3 x 30 m each side.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8 min easy movement and mobility.

sessions.coach_note: The work is dense, but technique still decides the load.

weeks.title: Build repeatable output
weeks.checkpoint: The aim is more quality work, not a new maximum. Repeatability is the performance skill.

sessions.title: Strength volume + unilateral control
sessions.purpose: Add quality strength volume and improve single-leg control for running and stepping.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 4 at RPE 7.5-8.

blocks.name: Secondary
blocks.instruction: Front squat or heavy goblet squat: 4 x 6 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Single-leg Romanian deadlift 3 x 8 each side; walking lunge 3 x 8 each leg; leg curl 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Calf raise 4 x 12; tibialis raise 3 x 15; suitcase carry 3 x 35 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: This week adds volume. Keep repetition speed consistent.

sessions.title: Extended easy aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Expand the base that supports faster running and recovery between hard efforts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min brisk walk into easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 40-50 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 8 min run / 1 min walk.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record whether pace stayed stable at the same effort.

sessions.coach_note: More aerobic fitness improves recovery from every other session.

sessions.title: Push press power + upper volume
sessions.purpose: Develop whole-body pressing power and keep enough volume for strength and muscle.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and progressive push-press sets.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Push press: 5 x 3 at RPE 7.5; seated 4 kg throw: 5 x 3. Full rest.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Dumbbell bench or bench press: 4 x 6 at RPE 7-8.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Weighted or assisted pull-up 4 x 5-8; chest-supported row 3 x 10; face pull 3 x 15.

blocks.name: Trunk
blocks.instruction: Hollow hold 3 x 20-30 sec; side plank 2 x 30 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: Separate power from conditioning. Every power rep should look aggressive and clean.

sessions.title: 400 m repeatability
sessions.purpose: Develop 2 km rhythm using the performance you have actually produced.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 6 x 400 m at current average 2 km pace with 2 min walk or jog recovery.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: 6 x 90 sec at RPE 8 with 2 min easy recovery.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Keep 400 m repetitions within 3 sec where possible.

sessions.coach_note: One hero repetition does not make a good interval session.

sessions.title: Five quality work intervals
sessions.purpose: Practise working hard, recovering and producing the same output again.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 4 min work / 2 min easy. During work complete 200 m run, 8 burpees, 12 step-ups total, 10 rows and 30 m farmer carry; use remaining time for easy movement.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 60 sec bike or row, step-back burpees and bodyweight step-ups.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Rule
blocks.instruction: Start each new round fully in control. Reduce reps if a round runs beyond 4 min.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk or bike.

sessions.coach_note: The fifth work interval should still resemble the first.

weeks.title: Highest general workload
weeks.checkpoint: This is the broad-development peak. Do not add extra tests, hard runs or conditioning.

sessions.title: Heavy doubles + maximum intent
sessions.purpose: Develop high force without the fatigue of repeated maximal attempts.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up; broad jump 5 x 2 with full reset.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 2 at RPE 8-8.5. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Pull skill
blocks.instruction: Secure mid-thigh isometric: 4 x 3 sec at RPE 9. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Rear-foot elevated split squat 4 x 6 each leg; hamstring curl 3 x 8; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Tibialis raise 3 x 15; heavy farmer carry 5 x 25 m.

sessions.coach_note: No missed lifts. Force and quality matter more than grinding.

sessions.title: Long easy aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Reach the highest easy aerobic duration before the midpoint deload.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk into very easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 45-55 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 9 min run / 1 min walk.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk, calf raise 2 x 12, tibialis raise 2 x 15.

sessions.coach_note: Long does not mean hard. Protect the quality run later in the week.

sessions.title: Heavy press + explosive throw
sessions.purpose: Push upper-body force higher while preserving throwing speed.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light throws.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg throw: 6 x 2 at full valid intent with full reset.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press: 5 x 3 at RPE 8-8.5. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 5 x 5-8; chest-supported row 3 x 8; overhead press 3 x 6 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 controlled sets; face pull 2 x 15.

sessions.coach_note: Low-repetition throws stay explosive. Do not turn them into conditioning.

sessions.title: Long 2 km pace intervals
sessions.purpose: Hold current 2 km rhythm for longer sections without a full test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 3 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 3 x 800 m at current 2 km pace with 3 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Speed finish
blocks.instruction: 4 x 200 m relaxed-fast with 75-90 sec recovery.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: 4 x 3 min at RPE 8 with 2.5 min easy recovery; omit the 200 m reps.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy running.

sessions.coach_note: If pace falls after rep two, adjust rather than forcing poor mechanics.

sessions.title: 24-minute soldier AMRAP
sessions.purpose: Bring running, lifting, stepping, pushing, pulling and carrying together.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: AMRAP x 24
blocks.instruction: 300 m run, 10 goblet squats, 10 step-ups each leg, 10-20 press-ups, 8 pull-ups or 12 rows, 40 m farmer carry.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 75 sec bike or row, incline press-ups and band rows.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Quality cap
blocks.instruction: Work at RPE 7-8. Keep one or two good reps available on every movement.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement; log rounds and where pace changed.

sessions.coach_note: Recover with the same intent that you train this week.

weeks.title: Midpoint test and deload
weeks.checkpoint: Retest, compare and reset. Future training uses the athlete you are now.

sessions.title: Midpoint strength check
sessions.purpose: Measure strength progress without taking a reckless maximum.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Strength check
blocks.instruction: Work to one set of 3 at RPE 8 on the trap bar or conventional deadlift. Record load and setup.

blocks.name: MTP check
blocks.instruction: Use the genuine device if available. Otherwise 3 x 3 sec secure rack pulls at RPE 8, logged only as a gym proxy.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Split squat 2 x 8 each leg; calf raise 2 x 12; tibialis raise 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy bike or walk.

sessions.coach_note: A deadlift or rack pull is not an official MTP score.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic recovery
sessions.purpose: Maintain the aerobic base while reducing fatigue before the run test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 25-35 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 3 x 15 sec relaxed accelerations.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 5-8 min calves, hips and ankles.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record freshness and any recurring pain.

sessions.coach_note: Nothing here should compromise Session 4.

sessions.title: Medicine-ball midpoint test
sessions.purpose: Measure throw progress and keep upper-body strength ticking over.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and 3-4 progressive practice throws.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 scored attempts.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench or dumbbell bench 3 x 5 at RPE 6-7; row 3 x 8; pulldown or pull-up 3 x 6-8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 easy sets and shoulder mobility.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare with Week 1 and note the cue that helped most.

sessions.coach_note: Testing ends after three scored attempts.

sessions.title: Midpoint 2 km assessment
sessions.purpose: Measure current running fitness and generate new training paces.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy run, drills, strides and the official-style 800 m progressive warm-up.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.instruction: Run 2 km at best sustainable effort. Record total time and splits.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Walk 5 min and jog easily for 8-10 min.

blocks.name: Recalculate
blocks.instruction: Use the new average 400 m or kilometre pace for Weeks 9-11.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare pacing as well as finishing time.

sessions.coach_note: A small improvement with better pacing is meaningful progress.

sessions.title: Easy movement + midpoint review
sessions.purpose: Reduce fatigue and turn the test results into a practical final block.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 25-30 min bike, row or brisk walk at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Movement
blocks.instruction: 2 easy rounds: 8 step-ups each leg, 10 press-ups, 10 rows, 20 m light carry, 30 sec plank.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 10 min calves, ankles, hips, upper back and shoulders.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Complete the midpoint worksheet and choose low or high ends of future ranges.

blocks.name: Recovery
blocks.instruction: Plan sleep, food and rest for Week 9.

sessions.coach_note: Leave the midpoint week motivated and recovered.

weeks.title: Turn fitness into performance
weeks.checkpoint: The final build begins. Faster work is supported by the base, not substituted for it.

sessions.title: Strength specificity + pull force
sessions.purpose: Convert the strength base into high-force, low-repetition work.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up; broad jump 4 x 3.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 4 x 3 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: Pull skill
blocks.instruction: Secure mid-thigh isometric: 4 x 3 sec at RPE 9. Rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Front squat or goblet squat 4 x 5 at RPE 8; single-leg Romanian deadlift 3 x 8; leg curl 2 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Calf raise 4 x 10; tibialis raise 3 x 15; farmer carry 4 x 35 m.

sessions.coach_note: Strength improves through intent and repeatability, not accidental extra reps.

sessions.title: Long easy aerobic run
sessions.purpose: Maintain the aerobic foundation while specific speed work becomes harder.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk into easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 45-55 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 9 min run / 1 min walk.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with 75 sec easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk and lower-leg mini-dose.

sessions.coach_note: Faster easy running is welcome only when it remains easy.

sessions.title: Upper contrast power
sessions.purpose: Pair high-force pressing with rapid force expression for the throw.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light throws.

blocks.name: Contrast
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds: bench press 4 reps at RPE 8, rest 60 sec, then 3 seated 4 kg throws; rest 2-3 min.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.instruction: Pull-up or pulldown 4 x 6; chest-supported row 4 x 8.

blocks.name: Overhead
blocks.instruction: Push press 4 x 3 at RPE 7.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 controlled sets; Pallof press 3 x 10 each side.

sessions.coach_note: If pressing fatigue kills throw speed, reduce the bench load.

sessions.title: 300 m speed reserve
sessions.purpose: Run slightly faster than current 2 km pace so assessment pace feels more controllable.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and 4 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 8-10 x 300 m at about 1-2 sec per 100 m faster than current 2 km pace; 90 sec walk or jog.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: 8 x 75 sec at RPE 8-9 with 90 sec easy recovery.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Aerobic finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Quality cap
blocks.instruction: Stop at 8 if pace drops more than 3 percent or mechanics deteriorate.

sessions.coach_note: Speed reserve is fast and relaxed, not sprinting.

sessions.title: Five soldier work intervals
sessions.purpose: Produce controlled whole-body output repeatedly under a clock.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 5 rounds: 5 min work / 2 min rest. Complete 250 m run, 8 alternating sandbag or dumbbell clean-to-shoulder reps, 10 press-ups, 10 rows, 30 m suitcase carry; easy movement with time left.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 60-75 sec bike or row; dumbbell deadlift instead of clean-to-shoulder.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Rule
blocks.instruction: Loads stay moderate and technique stays identical across all five rounds.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement and log round completion times.

sessions.coach_note: The clock creates structure, not permission to move badly.

weeks.title: Peak specific capacity
weeks.checkpoint: This is demanding but precise. Do not add random extra work.

sessions.title: Heavy doubles + lower-body power
sessions.purpose: Increase force while retaining speed and athletic movement.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Box jump or broad jump: 5 x 3 with full reset and safe landing.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 5 x 2 at RPE 8.5. Rest 3 min.

blocks.name: Hypertrophy
blocks.instruction: Walking lunge 3 x 8 each leg; hamstring curl 3 x 8; calf raise 4 x 10.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Tibialis raise 3 x 15; heavy suitcase carry 4 x 30 m each side.

sessions.coach_note: Power repetitions end when jump height or landing quality falls.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic maintenance
sessions.purpose: Keep the engine while the quality run and circuit reach their peak.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk into easy running.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 40-50 min at RPE 4-5.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 9 min run / 1 min walk.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 20 sec relaxed-fast with full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Walk 5 min and complete lower-leg mini-dose.

sessions.coach_note: This session creates capacity; it should not compete with Session 4.

sessions.title: Explosive upper-body peak
sessions.purpose: Emphasise speed and force without unnecessary muscle damage.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and progressive push-press sets.

blocks.name: Power strength
blocks.instruction: Push press: 6 x 2 at RPE 8 with full recovery.

blocks.name: Throw
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 6 x 2 at maximum valid intent.

blocks.name: Strength support
blocks.instruction: Dumbbell bench 3 x 6 at RPE 7; pull-up or pulldown 4 x 5-8; row 3 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Face pull 3 x 15; side plank 2 x 35 sec each side.

sessions.coach_note: This should feel powerful, not like a burnout.

sessions.title: Specific mixed intervals
sessions.purpose: Hold 2 km pace under controlled accumulated fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 3 x 800 m at current 2 km pace with 2.5 min recovery, then 4 x 200 m slightly faster with 75 sec recovery.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: 5 x 3 min at RPE 8 with 2 min easy recovery.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record all splits and whether the 200 m reps stayed relaxed.

sessions.coach_note: Specific does not mean maximal. Save all-out effort for testing.

sessions.title: 30-minute peak EMOM
sessions.purpose: Combine repeatable aerobic and muscular work in a clear, enjoyable format.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: EMOM x 30
blocks.instruction: Min 1: 10-14 bike or row calories. Min 2: 12 step-ups total. Min 3: 10-20 press-ups. Min 4: 8 pull-ups or 12 rows. Min 5: 40 m farmer carry. Min 6: rest. Repeat 5 times.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Reduce every target so each work minute finishes with 10-15 sec spare.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Optional partner
blocks.instruction: Partners alternate work and counting while keeping the same individual targets.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy walk or bike.

sessions.coach_note: The first round should look almost too controlled.

weeks.title: Rehearse and sharpen
weeks.checkpoint: Confidence comes from clean rehearsals, not last-minute punishment.

sessions.title: Final pull rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse high-force pulling while reducing total strength volume.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up and progressive deadlift sets.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 2 at RPE 8.

blocks.name: MTP rehearsal
blocks.instruction: If a genuine dynamometer is available, complete 2 official-style 5 sec attempts. Otherwise 3 x 3 sec secure rack isometrics at RPE 9.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Split squat 2 x 6 each leg; calf raise 3 x 10; tibialis raise 2 x 15.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Light carry 3 x 25 m and easy mobility.

sessions.coach_note: Record exactly what was tested; do not create a fake official score.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic + strides
sessions.purpose: Maintain aerobic fitness while allowing fatigue to fall.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walking.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 30-40 min at RPE 4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 5 x 15 sec smooth and fast with full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 5 min walk and lower-leg mobility.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record general freshness, not pace.

sessions.coach_note: Finish with spring in the legs.

sessions.title: Final medicine-ball rehearsal
sessions.purpose: Rehearse the exact test skill and retain upper-body strength.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and 3 progressive practice throws.

blocks.name: Rehearsal
blocks.instruction: Three official-style seated 4 kg medicine-ball attempts. Record the best valid distance.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench press 3 x 3 at RPE 7; pull-up or pulldown 3 x 5-8; row 2 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Press-ups 2 easy sets and mobility.

blocks.name: Cue
blocks.instruction: Write one technical cue to use on final test day.

sessions.coach_note: Once the three scored throws are complete, stop testing.

sessions.title: 1 km rehearsal + speed
sessions.purpose: Confirm 2 km rhythm and maintain speed without a full test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard run warm-up and strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 2 x 1 km at current 2 km pace with 4 min easy recovery.

blocks.name: Speed
blocks.instruction: 2-4 x 200 m relaxed-fast with 90 sec recovery.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: 2 x 4 min at RPE 8 with 4 min easy recovery; then stop.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy running.

sessions.coach_note: Finish believing you could complete another hard kilometre.

sessions.title: 18-minute confidence AMRAP
sessions.purpose: Repeat familiar patterns at reduced volume and finish confident.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard circuit warm-up.

blocks.name: AMRAP x 18
blocks.instruction: 300 m run, 8 goblet squats, 8 step-ups each leg, 8-15 press-ups, 8 pull-ups or 12 rows, 30 m farmer carry.

blocks.name: Target
blocks.instruction: Work at RPE 7. Compare movement quality with Week 7, not only rounds.

blocks.name: Foundation
blocks.instruction: Use 75 sec bike or row and scaled bodyweight movements.
blocks.alternative_rule: Use this instead of the primary prescription in the preceding work block. It is not additional work.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement and full recovery meal.

sessions.coach_note: Reduced volume is deliberate. Do not chase the Week 7 score.

weeks.title: Taper and final assessment
weeks.checkpoint: Fitness is built. Reduce fatigue, keep movement sharp and express the work.

sessions.title: Lower-body primer
sessions.purpose: Keep strength and pulling intent without creating fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard lower warm-up.

blocks.name: Main strength
blocks.instruction: Trap-bar or conventional deadlift: 3 x 3 at RPE 6.

blocks.name: Pull primer
blocks.instruction: Secure mid-thigh rack isometric: 3 x 2 sec at RPE 7, or omit if no safe setup.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: Goblet squat 2 x 6; calf raise 2 x 10; tibialis raise 2 x 12.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: 10 min easy movement.

sessions.coach_note: Everything should feel fast and easy. This is not a test.

sessions.title: Easy aerobic primer
sessions.purpose: Maintain rhythm and reduce stress before the final assessment.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 5 min walking.

blocks.name: Main aerobic
blocks.instruction: 20-25 min at RPE 3-4.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 4 x 12 sec relaxed-fast with full recovery.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: Gentle mobility and normal hydration.

blocks.name: Log
blocks.instruction: Record freshness, not pace.

sessions.coach_note: You cannot gain fitness this week, but you can hide it under fatigue.

sessions.title: Upper-body power primer
sessions.purpose: Keep the throwing pattern explosive without soreness.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: Standard upper warm-up and light practice.

blocks.name: Power
blocks.instruction: Seated 4 kg medicine-ball throw: 3 x 2 at 85-90 percent effort.

blocks.name: Strength
blocks.instruction: Bench or dumbbell bench 2 x 5 at RPE 6; row 2 x 8; pulldown 2 x 8.

blocks.name: Finish
blocks.instruction: One easy press-up set and mobility.

blocks.name: Cue
blocks.instruction: Write the single cue for the final throw.

sessions.coach_note: Stop while you feel powerful.

sessions.title: 2 km pace primer
sessions.purpose: Touch assessment pace without accumulating fatigue.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12 min easy running and drills.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: 4 x 200 m at current 2 km pace with 2 min full easy recovery.

blocks.name: Strides
blocks.instruction: 2 x 12 sec relaxed-fast.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 10 min very easy running or walking.

blocks.name: Prepare
blocks.instruction: Confirm route, footwear, timing device and assessment plan.

sessions.coach_note: The 200 m reps should feel controlled. This is a reminder.

sessions.title: Final fitness assessment
sessions.purpose: Measure the complete 12-week outcome using a consistent protocol.

blocks.name: General warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy cardio and dynamic movement.

blocks.name: Medicine ball
blocks.instruction: After progressive practice, complete 3 official-style seated 4 kg throws. Record the best valid result.

blocks.name: Mid-Thigh Pull
blocks.instruction: Use a proper dynamometer where available: 2 x 5 sec attempts with full recovery. Keep any gym proxy separate.

blocks.name: Run
blocks.instruction: Complete the 800 m progressive warm-up, then run 2 km at best sustainable effort. Record total time and splits.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Compare Weeks 1, 8 and 12. Record progress, lessons and the next objective.

sessions.coach_note: The result matters, but so does the more capable athlete built over twelve weeks.

session_order_notes: Session 1 - Lower-body strength + power + lower hypertrophy
Session 3 - Upper-body strength + medicine-ball power + upper hypertrophy
Session 5 - Soldier work capacity using AMRAPs, EMOMs and intervals

training_terms.short: Rating of perceived exertion. For strength, it is linked to how many technically good repetitions remain.
Repetitions in reserve - the number of technically good reps you believe remained.
Mid-Thigh Pull - an isometric pull against a fixed bar, measured on the official dynamometer.
Sustainable work that builds the engine for endurance and recovery.
Hard but controlled running near the point where fatigue rises quickly.
A short relaxed acceleration for speed and mechanics without heavy fatigue.
A work period separated by planned recovery.
Every minute on the minute. Complete the target, then use the remaining time to recover.
As many quality rounds or repetitions as possible within a time limit.
Training intended to add muscle, usually through controlled moderate-repetition sets and sufficient weekly volume.
Repeatable running slightly faster than current 2 km pace, not sprinting.
A deliberate reduction in training stress so previous work can be absorbed.
Reduced volume before testing so fitness can be expressed with less fatigue.
The scaled prescription. Foundation alternatives replace the main prescription; they are never extra work.
The primary prescription for users who can complete the movement and running standards with stable technique.

programme_principles: Get fitter: keep one genuinely easy aerobic session every week and one dedicated quality run.
Get stronger: progress the main lifts at RPE 6-8 and avoid missed lifts.
Build muscle: use deliberate 6-12 rep assistance work for legs, back, chest and shoulders.
Build power: perform jumps and throws fresh with low repetitions and full resets.
Build strength endurance: rotate quality AMRAPs, EMOMs and work intervals without treating fatigue as the goal.

standard_warmups.name: Lower strength
standard_warmups.instruction: 3-5 min easy cardio; ankle rocks x 8 each; glute bridge x 10; squat x 8; hinge x 8; split squat x 5 each; then 2-4 ramp sets.

standard_warmups.name: Upper strength
standard_warmups.instruction: 3-5 min easy cardio; wall slide x 8; band pull-apart x 15; scapular press-up x 8; light row x 10; then ramp sets.

standard_warmups.name: Quality run
standard_warmups.instruction: 8-12 min easy run; leg swings; A-march; ankling; 3-4 relaxed strides.

standard_warmups.name: Circuit
standard_warmups.instruction: 5-8 min easy cardio; rehearse one easy set of every movement; confirm loads and space.

progression_rules: Main strength: when every set is at or below target RPE with stable technique, add the smallest practical load.
Hypertrophy: reach the top of the rep range with 2-3 reps in reserve, then add a small load and return to the low end.
Easy aerobic: follow duration progression without forcing pace progression.
Intervals: use the high end only when repetitions stay within roughly 3 percent and mechanics remain controlled.
EMOM / AMRAP: add a small rep or load only when work remains repeatable; never increase both at once.

equipment_substitutions.limited: Heavy dumbbell or kettlebell deadlift / banded hinge
Two balanced water containers or a static hold
Bike or rower by time and RPE

recovery_non_negotiables: Eat enough to recover and include protein across meals plus carbohydrate around demanding sessions.
Start hydrated and replace fluid after high-sweat work.
Stop smoking because it works against aerobic fitness, recovery and readiness.
safety: Stop if pain changes technique or running stride.
Seek qualified advice for worsening pain, localised bone pain or swelling.
Seek urgent help for chest pain, fainting, neurological symptoms or unusual severe breathlessness.
Under-18 candidates should train with parent or guardian awareness and appropriate qualified supervision.

sources.label: UK Chief Medical Officers physical activity guidelines

assessment.source_of_truth: The current Army role page for the exact role.

tests.name: Mid-Thigh Pull
tests.protocol: Pull upward against a fixed bar set at mid-thigh for 5 sec. Two attempts; the highest dynamometer score counts.

tests.name: Seated 4 kg Medicine-Ball Throw
tests.protocol: Sit with the back against a wall and throw the ball as far as possible. Three attempts; the longest valid throw counts.

tests.name: 2 km Run
tests.protocol: After an 800 m progressive warm-up, complete a continuous 2 km on a flat course as fast as possible.

warmup_checklist: Mobilise ankles, hips, upper back and shoulders.
Complete progressive practice attempts without fatigue.
Use the official 800 m progressive warm-up before the 2 km run.

pacing.cue: At or fractionally slower than average target pace.
Hold cadence and do not chase somebody else's poor opening pace.
Expect discomfort; focus on posture, arms and the next marker.
Increase effort progressively without losing mechanics.
Use what remains and run through the line.

strength_rpe.use: Comfortably hard; most early strength volume
Hard but controlled; key strength development
Not used for normal training sets
